description: How closely a pull request is read, from the paths it changes. lanes.py is the reference classifier. A change is `sensitive` when any path matches a sensitive pattern; `light` when every path matches a docs pattern, or a tests pattern as an added file; `standard` otherwise. Patterns are matched against the path from the repository's root: `*` stays inside one directory, `**` crosses directories, and a leading `**/` also matches at the root.
